answer: Gate the admission inlet on earned history: a new identity must first author answers that pass jury in 2 earlier epochs before it can grade or sponsor others, with the pass stamped in copper on the ledger under its own key. A farm cannot shortcut this - the Nth clone has no past, and no oasis of ready-made passes exists to draw from: each clone must wait through 2 epochs and pass on its own merit, so 100 clones cost 200 epoch-passes of real work, sequential and unforgeable. Two prior passed answers, verified against the settled feed, open the gate; none, and the inlet stays shut.
